description: This file defines a Flutter widget called OnScreenKeyboard, which provides a TV-friendly on-screen keyboard suitable for DPAD navigation. It includes UI layout, focus management, and callback mechanisms for user interactions, making it suitable for full-screen modal use in TV applications.

classes.name: OnScreenKeyboard
classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays a TV-friendly on-screen keyboard with focus control and callbacks for text submission, cancellation, and changes.

classes.name: _OnScreenKeyboardState
classes.description: State class for managing the internal buffer, focus nodes, key specifications, and building the widget UI.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to present the on-screen keyboard as a modal dialog, returning the entered string or null if cancelled.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes focus nodes, key list, and sets focus on the first key post-layout.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up focus nodes and removes focus to prevent leaks.

methods.name: _buildKeys
methods.description: Constructs a list of key specifications including character keys and action keys.

methods.name: _notifyChanged
methods.description: Invokes the onChanged callback with the current buffer.

methods.name: _append
methods.description: Appends a character to the buffer and triggers change notification.

methods.name: _backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from the buffer.

methods.name: _space
methods.description: Appends a space to the buffer.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Invokes the onSubmitted callback with the current buffer.

methods.name: _handleBack
methods.description: Handles back key events to trigger cancellation.

methods.name: _previewText
methods.description: Returns the preview text, masked if obscurePreview is true.

methods.name: _handleKeyActivate
methods.description: Handles activation of keys via keyboard events, such as select or enter.

methods.name: _activateKey
methods.description: Performs actions associated with each key specification based on its type.
